scenario: Type rules per LEXP.7.1 — Int+Float promotes to Float; floor division returns Int; modulo preserves type. Three rules verify Int arithmetic stays Int, Int+Float promotes, and floor-div returns Int.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r_int_arith:
    T t where t.v * 2 + 1 == 11
->
    log critical "int"

rule r_floordiv_int:
    T t where t.v // 3 == 1
->
    log critical "floordiv"

rule r_mod_int:
    T t where t.v % 4 == 1
->
    log critical "mod"
